narration:0:1511402001:0.text: You lie on the bed in the Mystical House, dazed, with the strange feeling that you've been gone for ages.

say:4:1511403003:0.text: Ah! Your wards are so strong, it took all my strength just to reach you in this dream.

say:1:1511405001:0.text: The forest seems calm; there's no obvious sign of a Hypogean.
say:1:1511405001:0.source_cn: 薄暮丛林一切正常，似乎没有受到恶魔的侵扰。

say:6:1511405004:0.text: Ask around? About what? Hey, maybe I can help!
say:6:1511405004:0.source_cn: 找人？问什么？说不定我可以回答你们！

say:8:1511405006:1.text: Not really. You'll almost always find me tinkering around Lunadorf.
say:8:1511405006:1.source_cn: 你们来月湖村，碰到我是很正常的事啊。

say:9:1511405007:0.source_cn: 对了，你们要找人问什么？

choice_prompt:10:1511405007.source_cn: 对了，你们要找人问什么？

say:12:1511405009:0.text: The forest has been quiet! Sure, maybe a few of my inventions exploded—but a Hypogean? Absolutely not!
say:12:1511405009:0.source_cn: 薄暮丛林最近很平静，顶多就是我的几个失败发明闹出了一点...

say:13:1511405010:1.text: The message Magister Merlin received is clear: the Hypogean is hiding in the dream of a child who cannot wake.
say:13:1511405010:1.source_cn: 梅林收到的消息是：恶魔藏在一个长睡不醒的小孩的梦里。
say:13:1511405010:1.male: The message Magister Merlin received is clear: the Hypogean is hiding in the dream of a child who cannot wake.
say:13:1511405010:1.female: The message Magister Merlin received is clear: the Hypogean is hiding in the dream of a child who cannot wake.

say:14:1511405011:1.text: We need to find that child. Do you know anyone like that?
say:14:1511405011:1.source_cn: 所以，我们必须要找到那个孩子。你认识这样的人吗？

say:15:1511405012:0.text: Hmm... I don't recall anyone like that.
say:15:1511405012:0.source_cn: 长睡不醒……嗯，我好像没听说这样的事。

say:16:1511405013:0.text: I've been too busy testing my glimmerbloom-shaped tracking irrigator, so maybe I missed something. But <style="highlight">Granny Dahnie</style> would know! Nothing escapes her notice.
say:16:1511405013:0.source_cn: 我最近一直在研究荧荧花形追踪浇灌器，没怎么注意村里的事...

say:17:1511405014:0.text: Then please take us to her.

choice:10:0:1.text: We heard a Hypogean is hiding here.
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 有人告诉我，薄暮丛林出现了恶魔
choice:10:0:1.male: We heard a Hypogean is hiding here.
choice:10:0:1.female: We heard a Hypogean is hiding here.

choice:10:1:2.text: We need to find a child who can't wake up.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 我们要找一个长睡不醒的小孩
choice:10:1:2.male: We need to find a child who can't wake up.
choice:10:1:2.female: We need to find a child who can't wake up.

choice:3:1:2.text: Maybe it's still hiding within the dream.

choice:3:1:2.female: Maybe it's still hiding within the dream.

say:1:1511408001:1.text: You visit more faithfully than those boys, Eironn and Lorsan—always flitting off like the wind!
say:1:1511408001:1.source_cn: 梅林，你又来看望我了？埃隆和洛桑那两个小子真该学学你，...
say:1:1511408001:1.male: You visit more faithfully than those boys, Eironn and Lorsan—always flitting off like the wind!

say:2:1511408002:1.text: But I can tell from your face... this isn't a social call, is it?

say:2:1511408002:1.female: But I can tell from your face... this isn't a social call, is it?

say:4:1511408003:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is searching for a child who cannot wake! He says there's a Hypogean haunting his dream.

say:4:1511408003:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is searching for a child who cannot wake! She says there's a Hypogean haunting his dream.

say:5:1511408004:1.text: A Hypogean?! Merlin, tell me everything.

say:5:1511408004:1.male: A Hypogean?! Merlin, tell me everything.
say:5:1511408004:1.female: A Hypogean?! Merlin, tell me everything.

say:7:1511408006:1.text: I see... No wonder <style="highlight">Lanao</style> has been asleep for days. No medicine, no herb has stirred him.

say:9:1511408007:1.text: Yes. He must be the child you seek.

say:9:1511408007:1.male: Yes. He must be the child you seek.
say:9:1511408007:1.female: Yes. He must be the child you seek.

say:10:1511408010:1.text: Lanao is usually strong and lively. This endless slumber has left his parents desperate.
say:10:1511408010:1.source_cn: 兰奥一直是个健康的小孩，这次昏睡可把他父母吓得不轻。

say:11:1511408011:0.text: I was about to contact Bryon and Arden for help, but your arrival spares me the trouble.
